# Kinetic Energy Consulting

> Kinetic Energy Consulting is a UK commercial and sales consultancy for energy businesses, led by Martyn Sheridan. It works with owners, managing directors and boards on commercial strategy, sales performance and propositions. Its view is that most energy businesses do not have a market problem, they have a clarity problem, and that growth comes from doing fewer things properly.

It is not a marketing agency. It also builds online energy tools, including the UK Solar Calculator (https://uksolarcalculator.co.uk) and Half Hourly Insights (https://hhinsights.co.uk).

## Services
- [Go-to-market strategy](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/go-to-market-strategy.html): Decide which markets are worth winning, then build one joined-up plan for proposition, sales and marketing. Go-to-market strategy for UK energy businesses.
- [Value proposition development](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/value-proposition-development.html): Turn technical capability into a clear reason to buy. Customer-led value propositions for energy, decarbonisation and engineering businesses.
- [Sales process and pipeline](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/sales-process-pipeline-optimisation.html): Clear sales stages, honest qualification and a forecast you can trust. Sales process and pipeline optimisation for B2B energy businesses.
- [Bid and pursuit strategy](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/bid-and-pursuit-strategy.html): Bid on fewer opportunities and win more of them. Qualification, win strategy and proposal support for complex energy and public sector bids.
- [Market entry and expansion](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/market-entry-and-expansion-support.html): Test a new sector, region or acquisition before you commit money to it. Evidence-led market entry support for energy businesses and investors.
- [Partnership and channel strategy](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/partnership-and-channel-strategy.html): Find and structure the partners that bring revenue, not just a logo. Channel and partnership strategy for energy and technology businesses.
- [Marketing and demand alignment](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/marketing-and-demand-alignment.html): Get sales and marketing working to one plan, one audience and one set of numbers. Demand alignment for B2B energy businesses.
- [Recruiting the right people](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/recruiting-the-right-people.html): Hire sales and commercial people with the right capability and fit. Role design, shortlists and interview support from a senior sales leader.
- [Interim and fractional leadership](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/interim-and-fractional-commercial-leadership.html): Senior sales and commercial leadership for as long as you need it. Interim and fractional commercial director support for energy businesses.
- [Non-executive representation](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/non-executive-representation.html): Independent commercial challenge at board level. Non-executive representation for energy and B2B businesses, backed by real sales and market experience.
- [Commercial strategy and deal structuring](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/commercial-strategy-deal-structuring.html): Pricing frameworks, PPA structures, funding models and margin discipline. Commercial models for solar, storage, CHP and heat that work in the real world.
- [Sales performance and growth](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/sales-performance-and-coaching.html): Sales strategy, qualification, pipeline discipline, key account management and coaching for sales leaders in the UK energy sector.
- [Proposition and marketing](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/marketing-proposition-development.html): Clear propositions, sector positioning and sales tools such as calculators, whitepapers and case studies that support real sales conversations.
- [Digital project development](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/digital-project-development.html): We build online tools that let energy customers explore their own usage, demand and options. Case studies: UK Solar Calculator and Half Hourly Insights.

## Who it works with
- [Energy and decarbonisation solution providers](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/energy-and-decarbonisation-solution-providers.html): Help for solar, storage, heat, EV and energy efficiency businesses: sharper propositions, focused go-to-market plans and commercial models that protect margin.
- [Energy consultancies](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/energy-consultancies.html): Help energy consultancies stand out in a crowded advisory market, price their expertise properly and turn one-off projects into long-term clients.
- [Engineering and FM providers](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/engineering-fm-providers.html): Help for engineering and FM businesses moving from service contracts to energy and decarbonisation outcomes, with stronger offers and bid discipline.
- [New market entrants and tech](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/new-market-entrants.html): Help technology businesses and international entrants understand UK energy buyers, shape a credible proposition and find the fastest route to market.
- [Investors, funds and private equity](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/investors-funds-private-equity.html): Independent commercial review of energy businesses for investors and private equity: proposition, pricing, pipeline and the levers that drive value.
- [Leadership teams in transition](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/corporate-leadership-teams-in-transition.html): Help for leadership teams through mergers, restructures and market pivots: diagnose where commercial alignment has broken down and rebuild momentum.

## About
- [Our story](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/our-story.html): Why Kinetic Energy Consulting exists: energy businesses rarely lack ambition. They lack focus. We bring clarity and the discipline to deliver it.
- [Why Kinetic Energy?](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/why-kinetic-energy.html): Commercial clarity, sales discipline and a story that lands, from people who have run sales in the UK energy market. Not a marketing agency, not theory.
- [Experience](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/experience.html): Martyn Sheridan: thirty years in sales leadership and fifteen in UK energy, including E.ON and Centrica Business Solutions.
- [What people say](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/testimonials.html): What colleagues, clients and team members say about working with Martyn Sheridan on sales strategy, commercial change and team leadership.
- [Why not just use AI?](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/why-not-just-use-ai.html): Use AI, but know its limits. Where AI helps a sales team, where it falls short, and why commercial judgement still decides who wins.
- [Pricing](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/pricing.html): Day rate, fixed-fee project or retained advisory. Simple, transparent pricing for commercial and sales consultancy.
- [Return on investment](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/return-on-investment.html): Six ways sales and commercial consultancy pays for itself: better sales results, protected margin, focus, less delivery risk and outside challenge.
- [Get in touch](https://www.kinetic-energy.co.uk/contact.html): Get in touch with Kinetic Energy Consulting. Start with an honest conversation about your commercial and sales challenges.
